parsedVerdict.reasoning: ProductController is an Express HTTP adapter in the infrastructure layer. Its methods pull request parameters out, hand the work to the application use case (GetProductStockUseCase), serialize the result to JSON, and turn exceptions into HTTP status codes. All of these are transport and framework concerns, which belong in an infrastructure (adapter) file. The file contains no business rules, such as stock calculations or validation of domain invariants. It also has no persistence logic. Sending every error from getStock back as a 404 is a coarse way to map errors, but it is still a transport-level decision and not domain logic.
